subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded runner "Network connection lost" when LLM generates a tool call with large parameters (param generation latency > underlying request timeout)

question: Should OpenClaw change the default OpenRouter-routed Anthropic large tool-call behavior, or keep the current explicit timeout/header configuration path?
rationale: Current main has configurable timeout and native Anthropic streaming machinery, but the reported OpenRouter route still appears OpenAI-compatible; changing defaults could affect provider timeout semantics and proxy compatibility.

options.title: Require live proof before default changes
options.body: Keep this issue open, run a live OpenRouter reproduction on current main, and only then decide whether a default behavior change is warranted.

options.title: Document the workaround only
options.body: Treat `models.providers.openrouter.timeoutSeconds` and explicit provider headers as the supported operator workaround without changing defaults.

options.title: Add provider-specific streaming support
options.body: Investigate OpenRouter's contract for Anthropic tool-argument streaming and add a narrow opt-in or default only if upstream support is proven.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before default changes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, run a live OpenRouter reproduction on current main, and only then decide whether a default behavior change is warranted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider runtime policy, Anthropic/OpenRouter compatibility, and recent AI runtime ownership where steipete has the strongest current history signal.
